title: E1 Listening for Numbers, Days, Times and Prices – Lesson Audio

scripts.label: Script A – Doctor's surgery message
lines: Hello. This is the doctor's surgery. Your appointment is on Tuesday at ten o'clock. Thank you.
questions: Is the appointment on Monday? (No, it isn't.)
What time is the appointment? (Ten o'clock.)

scripts.label: Script B – At the shop
questions: Is the bread two pounds? (No, it isn't.)
How much is the milk? (Ninety p.)

scripts.label: Script C – My English class
lines: My English class is on Monday and Thursday. It starts at half past nine. It finishes at twelve o'clock.
questions: Is the class on Thursday? (Yes, it is.)
What time does it start? (Half past nine.)

scripts.label: Script D – The bus
questions: Is it bus number five? (No, it isn't.)
What time is the bus? (Four o'clock.)
